prompt: After a deploy, the web app sometimes goes completely white. The browser still asks for a script from the old build, the server's single-page-app fallback answers that missing file with the index page (200, text/html), and the browser rejects it as a module. Requests for missing files must get a 404 instead: anything under the assets path, or any path with a file extension. Extensionless client routes must keep the fallback to the index page. Serve the hashed build assets as immutable, and serve the index page with no-cache so a reload always picks up the new build.
